rubric.role_summary: Senior IMS core engineer responsible for integrating, operating, maintaining and troubleshooting IMS/VoLTE mobile-network nodes and services.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior IMS core engineer responsible for integrating, operating, maintaining and troubleshooting IMS/VoLTE mobile-network nodes and services.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- BSc in Telecommunication or Computer Science and at least 10 years of core telecommunications network experience in mobile networks.
- Working knowledge of 2G, 2.5G, 3G and LTE telecom networks, including the listed core-network elements.
- Understanding of IMS evolution, subsystems, functionalities, services and call flows.
- Knowledge of IMS network topology, interfaces, core parameters and features.
- Experience working on IMS core nodes.
- Experience with the specified signaling and protocols in configuration changes for IMS-based services.
- IMS platform operations and maintenance experience.
- Preparation and implementation of IMS-node configuration changes and node integration.
- Hands-on use of Wireshark or protocol analysis tools.
- Hands-on ability with Linux/Unix systems and a Linux shell.
- VoLTE troubleshooting and call-trace analysis.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Post-graduate studies.
- At least 2 years of scripting experience, such as Python or Bash.
- Experience working on core nodes, including CSFB and IMS nodes.
- IMS platform operations and maintenance, including alarm and fault handling, trace analysis, troubleshooting, backup/restore, preventive maintenance and node upgrades.
- Hands-on use of sniffers, Wireshark and testing tools in advanced mode.
- Understanding of 3GPP, ITU-T and ANSI standards.
- Understanding of roaming agreements and IR.21, including IREG testing.
- Writing and documentation skills for developing reports.
